name: Public Grants
description: Remote MCP server for finding, checking eligibility for, and drafting applications to 49 French public grant programmes including CIR, JEI, BPI, CNC, ADEME, and EIC Accelerator. Provides 21 tools plus 3 guided prompts for company onboarding, grant discovery, eligibility checks, application drafting, validation, export, and strategic briefing. Streamable HTTP at `https://grants.mrchief.ai/mcp/`; requires `Authorization: Bearer <key>` from https://grants.mrchief.ai/account.

notes: Create an account and API key at https://grants.mrchief.ai/account, then send Authorization: Bearer <key>. OAuth 2.0 device flow is also available.
